---
title: "2. Building Computers"
description: "Collaborative notes for rebuilding computers and installing Ubuntu in TAS."
---

> **These notes are unfinished intentionally.** Students will contribute once we begin rebuilding salvaged computers and installing Ubuntu.

We will document:

- major computer components
- safe handling and disassembly
- identifying reusable parts
- rebuilding and troubleshooting
- BIOS/UEFI basics
- storage and boot media
- installing Ubuntu
- testing the finished system
- what we learned from failures and fixes
